ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite PET Amyloid Simple Scores

Source: R/data.R
ADSP_PHC_PET_Amyloid_Simple.Rd

ADSP Phenotype Harmonization Consortium (PHC) - Composite PET Amyloid Simple Scores data. More information is available at https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Usage

data(ADSP_PHC_PET_Amyloid_Simple)

Format

A data frame with 4756 observations and 26 variables.

Source

https://adni.loni.usc.edu/data-samples/adni-data/

Details

  • ORIGPROT character Original study protocol , with options: ADNI4, ADNI1, ADNIGO, ADNI2, ADNI3

  • COLPROT character Study protocol of data collection , with options: ADNI4, ADNI1, ADNI2, ADNIGO, ADNI3

  • RID numeric Participant roster ID

  • PTID character Participant ID

  • SUBJID character Subject ID used in NIAGADS for the whole genome sequencing data files generated by the AD Sequencing Project.

  • VISCODE character Visit code

  • VISCODE2 character Translated visit code

  • PHC_LONIUID numeric LONI Image ID Range value: 75199, ..., 11394049

  • PHC_SCANDATE Date of scan Date: YYYY-MM-DD

  • PHC_Visit numeric Harmonized visit number Range value: 1, ..., 20

  • PHC_Age_PET numeric Participant's Age at PET Data Collection Range value: 50.7186858316222, ..., 98.0752908966461

  • PHC_TRACER character PET Radiotracer , with options: FBB, FBP, PIB, NAV

  • PHC_ACQUISITION_START numeric Acquisition start-stop time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 50, ..., 90

  • PHC_ACQUISITION_END numeric Acquisition start-stop time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 70, ..., 110

  • PHC_ACQUISITION_TIME numeric Acquisition start-stop time post-injection 1 = 30-60 ; 2 = 40-60 ; 3 = 40-70 ; 4 = 45-75 ; 5 = 45-90 ; 6 = 50-70 ; 7 = 60-90 ; 8 = 70-90 ; 9 = 70-110 ; 10 = 80-100 ; 11 = 90-110 ; 12 = 30-45 ; 99 = outside of acceptable range

  • PHC_QC_IMAGE numeric Determination if scan passed or failed quality control– image quality 0 = Fail ; 1 = Pass ; 2 = Pending

  • PHC_QC_TIMING numeric Determination if scan passed or failed quality control– acquisition time 0 = Fail ; 1 = Pass ; 2 = Pending

  • PHC_QC_NOTES numeric Notes related to failed quality control. 1 = Abnormal image ; 2 = Technical problem ; 3 = Anatomic abnormality ; 4 = Bottom of brain cut ; 5 = Early finish ; 6 = Early start ; 7 = Front of brain cut ; 8 = High glucose ; 9 = Late start ; 10 = Motion-induced attenuation artifact ; 11 = No attenuation or scatter correction ; 12 = Scan aborted early ; 13 = Severe motion ; 14 = Top of brain cut ; 15 = Wrong reconstruction parameters (16) Wrong voxel size ; 88 = Pass/Pending ; 99 = Other

  • PHC_COMPLIANT_ACQUISITION_START numeric Tracer compliant acquisition start time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 50, ..., 90

  • PHC_COMPLIANT_ACQUISITION_END numeric Tracer compliant acquisition stop time post-injection (minutes) Range value: 70, ..., 110

  • PHC_INJECTED_DOSE numeric Measure of injected radioligand dose (millicurie) Range value: 8.1, ..., 15

  • PHC_DYNAMIC numeric Whether dynamic (multiple frames available) or static 1 = static ; 2 = dynamic

  • PHC_CENTILOIDS numeric Centiloids (CLs) values converted from GAAIN summary cortical SUVR normalized by GAAIN whole cerebellum; See ADSP MRI-Free PET Methods document Range value: -63, ..., 194

  • PHC_AMYLOID_STATUS numeric Amyloid positivity determined by applying thresholds to the GAAIN summary cortical SUVR normalized by GAAIN whole cerebellum; See ADSP MRI-Free PET Methods document 0 = negative ; 1 = positive ; 9 = unknown

  • PHC_CL_FAIL logical Projected centiloid values for images that failed QC_TIMING A Boolean value: TRUE/ FALSE

  • update_stamp POSIXct: YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS
